name: io.github.masondelan/selvedge
title: Selvedge
description: Persistent decision memory for AI coding agents: rationale, rejected approaches, and entity history.

runtimeArguments.name: --from
runtimeArguments.description: The MCP server binary (selvedge-server) differs from the package name, so uvx needs --from.
Entry point that starts the MCP server over stdio. Plain `uvx selvedge` would launch the CLI instead.

environmentVariables.name: SELVEDGE_DB
environmentVariables.description: Override the SQLite path. Defaults to .selvedge/selvedge.db next to the codebase.
